newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL'S CPFL H1 NET JUMPS VS YEAR AGO.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL'S CPFL H1 NET JUMPS VS YEAR AGO.

text.p: Brazilian state-owned power firm Companhia Paulista de Forca e Luz (CPFL) released the following first-half 1997 results.
NOTE: Figures are in Brazilian reais and are not adjusted for inflation.
A company spokesman said CPFL's adjusted net profit totalled 75 million reais in the first half compared with an adjusted net profit of 48 million reais in the January-June period last year.
CPFL, which is owned by Sao Paulo state and is slated to be privatized later this year, posted a net profit of 118.9 million reais in 1996 and a loss of 51.5 million reais the previous year, he said.
The firm invested 121 million reais last year and 128 million in 1995, he added.
